verdict.rationale: AWS documents the core mechanics. Assuming an IAM role yields temporary session credentials with no long-term keys. Identity-based policies scope what those credentials can do. Permissions boundaries are a documented policy type for capping privileges. OIDC federation lets external workloads assume roles. AgentCore states it handles authentication and access control for agent calls to MCP servers, APIs and Lambda functions. missing for 10: an explicit agent-specific credential-scoping pattern or walkthrough, evidence detailing how boundaries prevent escalation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AgentCore's agent access controls.
